অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ

(কাস্টমস ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ২২ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২১ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ০৫ জুন, ২০১৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry in Bangladesh responsible for the administration of the country's economic and fiscal policies, including customs and indirect taxation.
Internal Resources Division: This government division functions under the Ministry of Finance and is responsible for policy formulation and oversight regarding the national revenue, including customs and value added tax administration.

Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to issue notifications regarding tax exemptions.
S.R.O. 139-AIN/2009: This previous notification is formally repealed by the current order.
Customs Act 1969: The order exercises powers granted under the Customs Act to amend provisions related to the First Schedule.
Hybrid motor car: A partial exemption of Supplementary Duty is granted for new, unused CBU hybrid motor cars with an engine capacity not exceeding 2500cc, provided they meet specific technological criteria.
The exemption applies only to vehicles manufactured and imported within specific timeframes and does not cover used or reconditioned vehicles.

Importers must provide manufacturer-certified documentation, possess battery charging facilities, and undergo a physical inspection by a designated committee to verify the hybrid status of the vehicle.
Vehicles exceeding 2500cc engine capacity are excluded from this concession and remain subject to standard duty and tax rates.
Supplementary Duty: The amount of Supplementary Duty exceeding a specified percentage rate is waived for qualifying hybrid motor cars imported as CBU units.

"পরিশিষ্ট-ক"
কমিটি গঠন
[শর্ত (ছ) দ্রষ্টব্য]

কমিটি গঠন :- নিম্নবর্ণিত সদস্য সমন্বয়ে কমিটি গঠিত হইবে, যথা:-

(ক) সংশ্লিষ্ট কাস্টম হাউসের কমিশনার কর্তৃক মনোনীত এডিশনাল কমিশনার/জয়েন্ট কমিশনার, যিনি উহার আহ্বায়কও হইবেন;

(খ) বাংলাদেশ প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় অথবা চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় অথবা খুলনা প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের যন্ত্রকৌশল বিভাগের বিভাগীয় প্রধান কর্তৃক মনোনীত একজন শিক্ষক, যিনি উহার সদস্য হইবেন;

(গ) বাংলাদেশ রোড ট্রান্সপোর্ট অথরিটি (বিআরটিএ) এর সহকারী পরিচালক পদ মর্যাদার নিম্নে নহেন এমন একজন কর্মকর্তা, যিনি উহার সদস্য হইবেন; এবং

(ঘ) সংশ্লিষ্ট শুল্কায়ন শাখার তত্ত্বাবধানকারী ডেপুটি/অ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট কমিশনার, যিনি উহার সদস্য সচিব হইবেন।

Committee for Customs Procedures: This clause mandates the formation of a committee to oversee specific customs-related procedures as referenced in the regulatory conditions.
The committee is composed of representatives from customs authorities, academic engineering departments, and transport regulatory bodies to ensure technical and administrative oversight.
Customs House: The Commissioner of the relevant Customs House is responsible for nominating an Additional or Joint Commissioner to serve as the convener of the committee.
Bangladesh Road Transport Authority: The authority must appoint an officer with a rank not lower than an Assistant Director to serve as a member of the committee.
Mechanical Engineering Department: The department head from designated public engineering universities is responsible for nominating a faculty member to participate as a committee member.
Customs Assessment Branch: The Deputy or Assistant Commissioner supervising the relevant assessment branch shall serve as the member secretary of the committee.

Hybrid motor car: The committee report form requires an official certification determining whether an imported motor vehicle qualifies as a hybrid motor car.
The certification process is conducted in accordance with the criteria established in the National Board of Revenue notification dated June 5, 2014.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue issued notification number 121-AIN/2014/2485-Customs, which provides the regulatory basis for identifying and classifying motor vehicles as hybrid or non-hybrid for customs purposes.
